about: Package TOOLS1 (T2): suggested skill prices from the workbench's measured worth (tools/bench/bench.js skill --all), for the owner to review. Nothing here is applied: canonical/skill-costs.json is unchanged. Only skills mispriced at medium or high confidence are listed. worth / price / net in budget points (2A + H + S).
